source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The Demolisher can fire its demolisher battle cannon into **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** if it is the only friendly unit **engaged** with that target. With any of its ranged weapons, skip the **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** penalty that would apply because the Demolisher is engaged.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
